translations.reason: Final native tblastn composition significance heaps to original bounded result containers
translations.validation: Standalone compilation and existing forward protein smoke through real preliminary EngineCore/collector/CBS2/linking/heap pipeline: source score253, displayed bits102/E3.21e-36,60 identities/positives and matching coordinates. Additional two-query/two-subject forward/reverse smoke returns four expected lists in source subject tie order1 then0, each with doubled database E-value. Full parity and speed are not claimed.
translations.adaptations: Owned Box<BlastHSPList> values replace source void* contexts/pop pointers. Same per-query heap pop, original HitListNew/Update and result reverse order; no generic replacement top-k algorithm.

data.adaptations: Typed f64 constant retains original macro value0.002 used by ordinary tblastn source redo heap initialization when PSI options are null.
data.validation: Value and use checked against blast_kappa.c default inclusion threshold initialization.

integration: Expose protein_search and exports search_protein_database, ProteinSearchResults, ProteinSearchError. Signature search_protein_database(&PreparedProteinBatch,&NucleotideDatabase). Results shape matches nucleotide search: results/query_ids/subject_ids/query_info plus ungapped_stats/gapped_stats and preliminary/traceback/early-terminated subject-list counts.

Native DB orchestration calls source s_BlastSearchEngineCore over all six raw gapped-frame lists, source collector configured forCBS2, source ReverseSort and per-query reverse-array consumption (BlastHSPStream sort_on_read=true), source global BlastCompo_EarlyTermination, actual per-match CBS2 redo, source heap WouldInsert/Insert using pre-normalization best_scores, and exact s_FillResultsFromCompoHeaps. Native orchestration is not falsely mapped as a full port of multithreaded Blast_RedoAlignmentCore.

Heap threshold is original hitlist_size500 and inclusion Ecutoff0.002. Source does not use ordinary final expect_value10 as heap inclusion cutoff. List evaluation still reaps at its configured expect_value. Source E-value/score/subject-ordinal tie behavior remains in translated original heap and HitListUpdate helpers.
Low-score feedback to preliminary gapped extension is retained only if source low_score array is enabled; uses collector heap low_score and original low_score_perc scaling.

Current explicit5,000,000 nucleotide subject cap prevents silently bypassing original chunking. It is temporary and must be removed only when actual source translated chunk orchestration is available. Empty/short-subject setup limitations inherited from ProteinInitialSearch remain to be completed; no full parity claim.

HSP query coordinates remain local protein offsets and subject coordinates local translated frame offsets. OIDs index subject_ids, contexts index query_info. Parent report renderer must convert translated subject coordinates using actual nucleotide length/frame.
superseded_limit_note: The earlier temporary5M nucleotide limit has been removed: subject-chunk and protein-chunks integrations now bind original5M/100 geometry in nucleotide or translated-AA coordinates respectively. See those integration records.
